title: Dr Frost Arctic Strawmelon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Strawmelon Ice blends notes that are both familiar and exotic into one irresistible combination. You’ll experience the soft, summery succulence of perfectly ripe strawberries on the inhale, enhanced by the lush, delicate sweetness of juicy watermelon. And for maximum refreshment, a subtle layer of crisp menthol adds a note-perfect hint of crushed ice that truly takes this classic fruit combo to the next level. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, designed to replicate the bold and intense taste associated with disposable vapes. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for use with low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits. The 100ml bottle provides room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical option for adult smokers and vapers who appreciate bold flavours and exceptional value.
